name: Wrkr Ltd
summary: Wrkr Ltd, formerly Integrated Payment Technologies Limited, is based in Sydney and was established in 2007. It provides digital payment and remittance solutions, centred on the wrkr cloud platform for managing compliance messaging. Wrkr PAY is a superannuation gateway and clearing house for processing wages and super contributions, and Wrkr SMSF Hub supports self-managed super funds.
